extension.summary: Kodi subtitle aggregator: Titulky.com + OpenSubtitles.com in one ranked list, AI translation as fallback
extension.description: Shows in Kodi subtitle services list. Searches Titulky.com and OpenSubtitles.com in parallel and merges the results into one ranked list. Finished Czech and Slovak subtitles download directly; English results are offered as a source for translation through the Subtrans backend, which only runs when you pick one. Replaces the separate Titulky.com and OpenSubtitles addons.
extension.news:
0.9.0: MulenStream resolver integration and full episode search/translation using season and episode metadata
0.8.2: personal repository build provisions configured subtitle accounts automatically during a normal repository install/update
0.8.1: film-only hardening: strict title identity prevents unrelated fulltext matches; native CZ/SK and English OpenSubtitles searches no longer compete for one result limit; Kodi VFS local downloads fixed; ASS/VTT/SUB extensions preserved; archive payloads reused; private credentials persist across public updates; episodes are explicitly ignored
0.8.0: Titulky.com and OpenSubtitles.com now run inside the addon as parallel sources sharing one ranking; finished CZ/SK subtitles download directly without touching the translation backend, English results stay opt-in per click; CP1250 decoding and multi-file archive selection; per-source timeouts so one broken source cannot empty the list
0.7.3: faster subtitle result loading on Shield/NAS-style playback by skipping expensive OpenSubtitles moviehash computation for non-local paths; local subtitle translation and backend stability improvements continue
0.7.2: robust local subtitle translation for Kodi VFS paths (smb/nfs/special paths) so manually downloaded subtitles next to a movie can be detected, read and translated instead of falling back to OpenSubtitles
0.7.1: pre-translation subtitle validation (rejects broken/forced/SDH sources with a clear reason before AI translation runs, saving tokens) + stronger forced/foreign/SDH/CC penalty in candidate scoring
0.7.0: automatic FPS-mismatch repair + backend-shared per-video offset memory
0.6.0: hash-based OpenSubtitles matching + per-video subtitle offset memory
0.5.2: verified the production-backed subtitle flow in local Kodi before release
0.5.0: switch subtitle translation to the OpenAI backend and remove legacy local translation mode

En poques paraules, vivim i respirem comunitat i això és precisament el que ens fa diferents.
